item.title: Alberta government to require cleanup funds to be set aside for each new well drilled
item.description: The Alberta government has introduced legislation that would require oil and gas companies to set aside funds for the future cleanup of every new well drilled.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: The Alberta government has introduced legislation that would require oil and gas companies to set aside funds for the future cleanup of every new well drilled. If passed, the bill would create the Resource Asset Closure Assurance and Stewardship Fund. Money would follow each well through its life cycle, even if ownership changes hands. Companies would be required to make an initial payment of up to $50,000 followed by equal annual payments for up to 10 years. The new rules are expected to apply to wells drilled after April 1, 2027. Between the payments and compound interest that accrues over time, there should be enough money available to fund the eventual cleanup of a typical well, Brian Jean, minister of energy and minerals, told a news conference Wednesday. “We are making sure that when these wells are drilled, we have something set aside for them to be cleaned up so that the taxpayers are not on the hook.” Managing the backlog of old oil and gas wells that have no one legally responsible for them, due to bankruptcy and other factors, has been a long-running issue in Alberta. Farmers have raised concern about contamination from inactive wells on their land. Cleanup of such sites is managed through the non-profit Orphan Well Association and is funded through an industry fee, the amount of which the Alberta Energy Regulator recommends to the Alberta government every year. That fee would continue to exist. The Orphan Well Levy for the 2026-27 fiscal year is $154.56 million, up from $144.45 million the previous year, though the well association has pegged total cleanup costs of its inventory at $1.66 billion. The latest monthly numbers from the Orphan Well Association say there are 7,328 wells are waiting to be decommissioned, which involves permanently dismantling equipment so that the site is safe. Another 9,258 sites are in need of reclamation, which means restoring the land so it’s similar to its original state. In the 2025-26 fiscal year, the average cost of decommissioning a well was $28,800 and for reclaiming a site, it was $27,700. Under the new rules — proposed as part of a broader bill that also includes new restrictions for data centres, greater illegal dumping fines and other matters — a company would be eligible to receive the funds that were set aside once reclamation is complete. If the well becomes orphaned, the funding would be transferred to the Orphan Well Association. “We’re making good on a promise that we made to Albertans to stop the flow of unfunded wells to the Orphan Well Association,” Jean said. “After these changes are put into effect, no new oil and gas well will end up at the OWA without industry-paid-for closure funding.” Terry Schmidtke, who chairs the Alberta Small Producers Group, said the changes will give junior oil and gas companies greater confidence to buy and sell producing wells that are drilled after the rules take effect. “By ensuring cleanup funding stays with each well when ownership changes, smaller producers can continue to invest and grow while meeting their long-term cleanup obligations and keeping Albertans employed in the industry right across the province,” Schmidtke said in the province’s news release. Farmers have long demanded greater assurances that oil and gas sites on their land will be properly cleaned up, Peter Dobbie, a property rights advocate, said in the provincial release. “These changes should ensure that any new wells drilled will be cleaned up and returned to full agricultural use when they stop producing.” This report by The Canadian Press was first published Nov. 18, 2026. Lauren Krugel, The Canadian Press

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Anthropic's initial public offering is poised to create thousands of paper millionaires among current and former employees, in what could rank among the largest employee wealth windfalls in Silicon Valley history.   The offering is expected to unleash a wave of new wealth across the AI sector, rewarding everyone from early researchers and engineers to administrative staff who received stock grants as the Claude maker raced from startup to one of the world's most valuable companies. The IPO filing shows the amount of wealth embedded in employee stock awards, but not how that wealth is distributed among workers. As a result, outside estimates vary widely. Hill, a San Francisco marketplace for private-company shares, estimates 598 non-founder employees will hold at least $100 million in equity after the initial public offering, which is slated to open on the Nasdaq on Thursday at $83 a share, above its initial target range that would value the company at up to $1.4 trillion, according to a person familiar with the information.

Private-markets research firm Sacra estimates that roughly 2,800 current and former Anthropic employees could hold at least $1 million of pretax vested equity at a $1.35 trillion valuation, the middle of the price range.  The firms say their estimates are model-based and use public information. Reuters could not independently verify the estimates, which reflect factors including vesting periods, exercises, tender transactions, option awards, restricted stock units, award timing, headcount and employee retention rates. The filing does not disclose sums due individuals. But the wealth potentially shared by employees is vast.  Anthropic option holders were sitting on $119 billion of paper gains as of September 30, at a weighted average exercise price of $2.91 per share, the company disclosed. About $73 billion of that amount had vested through service and could be exercised immediately.  Anthropic did not respond to a comment request on the estimates. "The idea of equity appreciating to an amount that is life-changing is something that people strive for," Hill CEO Andrew Benson said. "It doesn't get better than this." EQUITY AT ENTRY LEVEL Workers who joined the firm when it started five years ago —  even in administrative positions and entry-level jobs — could be sitting on life-changing wealth, reflecting their holdings of stock options that carry exercise prices of less than $1.  Options granted through 2023 and still outstanding at the end of that year carried an average exercise price of 52 cents, the filing shows.  At SpaceX, which was founded in 2002 and went  public in June in a record-busting IPO, many of the employees who became millionaires had worked there for more than a decade.    "Early employees who started in a very junior role should have actually a better financial outcome than somebody who joined in a very senior role right before the IPO," Benson said, referring to Anthropic. Non-founder Anthropic employees can sell up to 10 per cent of their holdings on the first trading day, and up to another 35 per cent after fiscal 2026 earnings. EARLY HIRES REAP REWARDS Founded in 2021, the Claude maker expanded its workforce rapidly alongside the AI boom, growing to about 5,300 employees as of September 30 from roughly 940 at the end of 2024. As it hired aggressively, the company used stock-based compensation as a key recruiting tool. A May 2024 job posting for an administrative business partner role shows how the benefits of Anthropic's stock awards extended beyond AI researchers and engineers.  The position, which involved scheduling and managing calendars for company leaders, coordinating conference logistics and handling expense claims and reimbursements, paid an annual salary of $140,000 to $190,000.  The posting added that equity would be "a major component of the total compensation" beyond the salary, indicating that administrative and support staff were also eligible for stock awards alongside cash pay. That year, Anthropic said it granted employees options at an average exercise price of $1.30 per share. "And as we know from several anecdotes after the SpaceX IPO, this is often enough to help people down the organization chart do quite well in IPO," said Marcelo Ballve, head of research at Sacra. Anthropic granted CFO Krishna Rao 14 million stock options in 2024, also with a $1.30 exercise price, according to the filing. At the IPO price range, those options would carry roughly $1 billion in gross intrinsic value, before exercise costs and taxes. Ballve said that equity awards for administrative, support and entry-level roles are not uncommon at venture capital-backed companies. Historically, though, many companies phased out equity grants at hiring for these roles as they scaled up and salaries became more competitive, moving to performance- and tenure-based grants instead. After Anthropic goes public, the company will likely reserve upfront equity grants solely for recruiting top talent, he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル指数1年7カ月ぶり高値、12月利上げ観測強まる
item.description: ［ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、主要通貨に対するドル指数が１年７カ月ぶりの高値を更新し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル指数1年7カ月ぶり高値、12月利上げ観測強まる 5:32 配信

２００９年１１月撮影　REUTERS/Yuriko Nakao（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　１８日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、主要通貨に対するドル指数が１年７カ月ぶりの高値を更新した。連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事のタカ派的な発言に加え、このところの米経済指標を受け、ＦＲＢが来月の会合で追加利上げに動くとの観測が一段と強まっていることがドル買いを誘っている。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．３％高の１０３．８７と、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。ドルの上昇を受け他の主要通貨は数カ月ぶりの安値圏に押し下げられており、ユーロ／ドル は０．３％安の１．０９６４８ドル。一時は２５年４月以来の安値を付けた。

ドル／円は１５９．３９５円近辺とほぼ横ばい。日銀の植田和男総裁は１８日の参院特別委員会で、今後の政策運営に関し、現在の金融環境が緩和的であることを引き合いに「今後の経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて政策金利を引き続き引き上げ、金融緩和の度合いを調整していくことが適切」との考えを示し、追加利上げの必要性を改めて強調したものの、円相場は依然として、当局が７月に円買い介入を実施した水準に近い水準で推移している。

ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡ってはウォラーＦＲＢ理事がこの日、ＣＮＢＣのインタビューに対し、インフレによって国民の物価に対する心理が変化しつつあることを懸念しており、ＦＲＢはインフレに一段と積極的に対応する必要があるとの認識を示した上で、１２月の会合で０．５％ポイントの利上げを決定するか、来年に一段と速いペースで利上げを進める方針を市場に示すべきとの考えを示した。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が将来の政策方針に関する明確な手掛かり（フォワードガイダンス）の提示を避けていることから、市場参加者はＦＲＢの次の一手を見極めるため、経済指標や他の当局者の発言にこれまで以上に注目。米労働省が先週発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇し、市場予想（０．３％）を上回った。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で０．２５％ポイントの利上げが決定されるとの観測は完全に織り込まれているほか、０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げが決定される可能性もわずかながら織り込まれている。

マネックスＵＳＡのトレーディング部門シニアディレクター、フアン・ペレス氏は「ＦＲＢは現時点で利上げに極めて積極的な姿勢を示しており、場合によっては大幅な利上げも辞さない構えに見える」と指摘。「こうした見方がまさに現在のドル相場を支えている」と述べた。

ＦＲＢがこの日に公表した１０月２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣの議事要旨で、ＦＲＢ当局者が当面は政策金利を現行水準に据え置くことで一致したものの、インフレ抑制に向けた対応を一段と強化する必要に迫られるリスクが高まっているとの見方を示していたことが判明。「ほぼ全て」の参加者は経済が想定通りに推移した場合、追加利上げが必要になるとの見方で一致したが、一部の参加者はインフレが一段と根強くなり、現在の想定以上に「引き締め的な政策スタンスへの転換」が必要になる可能性があるとの認識を表明。「２人程度」が今後発表されるインフレ指標が好ましくない内容になれば、０．５％ポイントの利上げが必要になる可能性があると主張した。

ＬＰＬフィナンシャルのチーフエコノミスト、ジェフリー・ローチ氏は「インフレ指標は１１月と１２月に改善する可能性が高く、ＦＯＭＣは０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施するものの、より大幅な利上げを行う必要性は低い」と予想。ただ「来年第１・四半期には金融政策が一段と引き締め方向に向かう公算が大きい」との見方を示した。

ＣＭＥフェドウオッチによると、向こう１２カ月間でＦＲＢの政策金利は約０．７５％ポイント引き上げられ、４．５０─４．７５％に達すると見込まれている。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 159.33/159.36

始値 159.36

高値 159.47

安値 159.16

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.0973/1.0976

始値 1.0962

高値 1.0981

安値 1.0954

item.title: 原油1％超安、供給過剰観測が重し 米在庫が予想超え
item.description:
Georgina McCartney
[ヒューストン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Georgina McCartney

[ヒューストン １８日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は１％超下落した。米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）が発表した米原油・燃料在庫が予想を上回って積み増しとなり、供給過剰観測が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．１９ドル（１．２８％）安の１バレル＝９１．９５ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．７５ドル（３．２％）安の８３．２６ドルと、８月２６日以来の安値を付けた。

取引時間中にブレントは２ドル超、ＷＴＩは４ドル超値下がりした。

ＥＩＡによると、１３日までの週の米原油在庫は３４０万バレル増の４億１７８０万バレルだった。ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想は５万８０００バレルの増加だった。

item.title: 相次ぐ米システム障害、急増するセキュリティーパッチ適用が一因か＝専門家
item.description:
AJ Vicens
[１８日 ロイター] - 米当局者やサイバーセキュリティーの専門家によると、米国でこのところ相次い...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
相次ぐ米システム障害、急増するセキュリティーパッチ適用が一因か＝専門家 4:57 配信

Microsoft Outlookのロゴと「Global Outage」という文字。11月13日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration（ロイター） AJ Vicens

[１８日 ロイター] - 米当局者やサイバーセキュリティーの専門家によると、米国でこのところ相次いでいる一連のシステム障害について、人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及に伴うセキュリティーパッチ（修正プログラム）の適用が、主因の一つである公算が大きい。

先週には、マイクロソフトの業務ソフト「マイクロソフト３６５」で発生した大規模障害により、サービスが１日以上停止した。連邦航空局（ＦＡＡ）は航空管制センターの通信障害を受けて、全米で航空機の離陸停止を指示したほか、ユナイテッド航空、ＪＰモルガン・チェース、アップルなどでも障害が発生した。

ルビオ米国務長官は今週、企業によるパッチ適用作業が時に「システムの動作に短期的な混乱を引き起こしている」との認識を示した。

クレイトン米国家情報長官は１８日、下院国土安全保障委員会の公聴会で、これらの障害は組織的な攻撃や国家が関与する攻撃によるものではないとの見方を示した。その上で、コンピューターシステムの処理速度や能力が「著しく向上」する一方、「レガシー」システムや旧式機器の老朽化が、はるかに速いペースで進んでいると指摘した。

サイバーセキュリティー企業Ａセキュリティーの共同創業者兼最高技術責任者（ＣＴＯ）、ユバル・イツチャコフ氏は、「ＡＩによって重大な脆弱性の発見が迅速かつ低コストになった一方、即時のパッチ適用を必要とする欠陥の数も増えている」と指摘した。

別のサイバーセキュリティー企業クォリスによると、マイクロソフトは今月、１２００件超のソフトウエア脆弱性に対処している。前年同月比で約２０倍に相当するという。

前出のイツチャコフ氏は「緊急パッチは多くの場合、完全なテストサイクルを経ることなく数時間以内に基幹インフラへ適用される」と指摘。ネットワーク機器やシステムの中核部分に変更が加えられ、システムに大きな影響を与るため、「変更のスピードや規模そのものが障害の原因となる」との見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：世界の航空運賃高止まりか、燃料費負担軽減でも乗客に恩恵届かず アングル：航空会社の機内Ｗｉ―Ｆｉ競争過熱、スターリンクとアマゾンが主導権争い 焦点：「ミュトス」登場で米銀はシステム修正に奔走、サービスに影響も アングル：ユナイテッド航空のアメリカン合併案、反トラスト法懸念で懐疑論 11/19(木) 5:51 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Carney striking trade deals at ‘lightning speed’ amid diversification push: expert
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney is moving fast to secure new trade deals as his government attempts to make Canada less dependent on the U.S., but there’s reason to be optimistic that an agreement between ...
item.dc:creator: Jordan Fleguel
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Mark Carney is moving fast to secure new trade deals as his government attempts to make Canada less dependent on the U.S., but there’s reason to be optimistic that an agreement between Ottawa and Washington could come soon, an expert says. “Canada has successfully concluded several free trade agreements with our Association of Southeast Asian Nations counterparts and with the Philippines at kind of a lightning speed,” Margaret Kim, international trade counsel at Gowling WLG, told BNN Bloomberg Wednesday. “These are all part of Canada’s efforts to diversify trade away from the United States given the increasing complexity of our trade relations.” Kim’s comments came on the same day Carney met with U.S. President Donald Trump on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China, where the two leaders “discussed the work underway to reach a mutually beneficial trade agreement,” according to a post-meeting readout. While trade negotiations with the U.S. remain top of mind for Carney’s government, he’s also been focused on building Canada’s economic relationship with China, the world’s second largest economy. Carney’s trip began with an announcement that Canada would drop some restrictions on imports of Chinese steel and aluminum in exchange for greater market access for Canadian pork, seafood and other agricultural products. “I think overall the tariff relief is a positive development for sure, especially for those in the pork and seafood industry,” said Kim. “We will see how this renewed sense of economic co-operation between Canada and China further develops… from a legal perspective we have to be mindful that these are provisional arrangements short of a full-fledged free trade agreement, which would give us and businesses more certainty.” Kim said Canada and China have signalled that “this is the first of many further discussions to be had,” which will likely include talks related to the sale of Chinese electric vehicles (EVs) in Canada. “I think in the area of EVs, certainly China is interested in bringing more China-manufactured EVs into the Canadian market,” she said. “But from the Canadian perspective, I think prime minister Carney has clearly stated that it has to be within the terms that are acceptable within the realities of the Canada–United States–Mexico Agreement (CUSMA).” ‘Stay optimistic’ The future of CUSMA and the broader trading relationship between Canada and the U.S. remains uncertain, as the two neighbours have yet to strike a new deal that would end a monthslong trade war. Kim said despite the diplomatic tensions and industry-specific tariffs and counter tariffs currently in place, she doesn’t see CUSMA “going anywhere,” but added that “certainly, there will be different versions of it.” Much of the negotiations between the Carney and Trump governments have taken place behind the scenes, Kim noted, saying that the two leaders meeting face to face on Wednesday is a good sign. “I think we have to stay optimistic,” she said, “and see how it shakes out.” With files from CTV News’ Graham Richardson and The Canadian Press

item.title: トランプ氏の「平和評議会」、イスラエル・ハマス双方を非難 ガザ戦争終結巡り
item.description:
Alexander Cornwell
[エルサレム １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Cornwell

[エルサレム １８日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領が主導するパレスチナ自治区ガザの暫定統治機関「平和評議会」は国連に提出する報告書で、イスラエルとイスラム組織ハマスのいずれもが敵対行為を停止するという確約を十分に履行していないとして非難した。イスラエルがほぼ連日ガザを空爆するほか、ハマス戦闘員もイスラエル軍への攻撃を続けており、昨年１０月に合意された停戦は崩壊するかどうかの瀬戸際に立っている。

停戦合意後２回目となる報告書をロイターが確認した。ニューヨークで今月開かれる国連安全保障理事会で調査結果が提示される見通し。ハマス高官はこの報告書を「偽情報」と一蹴した。

報告書では、主要なリスクとして合意内容と現実との隔たりを指摘。停戦により大規模戦闘は収まったものの、ハマスの武装解除やイスラエル軍の撤退、復旧の開始などは事実上停滞していることを踏まえ、住民はテントや瓦礫（がれき）の中で冬を迎えることになるとして目に見える成果をもたらさない停戦は続かないと指摘した。

ハマスは今年７月、武器を放棄し、ガザの統治を文民による暫定当局に移管するという計画に合意したが、イスラエルはハマスが解体されるまで撤退しないとして拒否している。

報告書では、ハマスに代わるパレスチナ人の民間治安部隊を訓練・配備する取り決めについて、イスラエル政府による「決断が欠けている」と批判した。このほか、イスラエルによる支援物資などの制限や、資金不足も重なり、ガザ住民が季節的な洪水に対応する能力が阻害されているとした。一方、ハマス側はガザに持ち込まれる物品に対して課税し、基本物資の供給に影響しているという。

item.title: 米国防長官、ベネズエラと軍事協力で新たな合意 マドゥロ氏拘束後初訪問
item.description: [カラカス １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カラカス １８日 ロイター] - ヘグセス米国防長官は１８日、ベネズエラとの軍事協力に関する新たな合意を発表した。米軍の特殊部隊が１月にマドゥロ大統領を拘束し退陣させて以降、ヘグセス氏にとって初めての同国訪問となる。

ヘグセス氏は首都カラカスでロドリゲス暫定大統領と会見し、合意は共同訓練や情報共有など、両国の軍事協力の幅広い分野を対象としていると説明。ロドリゲス氏は、今回の合意が「共通の脅威」への対処に寄与し、ベネズエラ軍の訓練を強化することになると語った。

ヘグセス氏は、協力によって麻薬密売組織に対する共同行動が大幅に強化されるとし、こうした組織に向けて「おまえたちを追い詰め、見つけ出し、殺害する」と述べた。

ヘグセス氏は中南米歴訪の最初の訪問地としてカラカスに立ち寄った。１８日にはコロンビアを訪れ、軍事装備品を引き渡すほか、同国政府と安全保障協力について協議する予定だ。

同氏は８月、コロンビアの武装組織に対する共同攻撃の可能性に言及していた。

トランプ米大統領の中南米政策は、当初の重点だったパナマ運河から、対象を大幅に広げている。米軍が２０２５年に麻薬密輸に関与した疑いのある船舶への攻撃を開始して以降、２００人以上が死亡した。

カラカスでの集会で演説したヘグセス氏は、米州全域で米国の優位性を主張する１９世紀のモンロー主義とトランプ氏の名前を掛け合わせた「ドンロー主義」に言及。「これがドンロー主義だ。ベネズエラはこの地域で最も攻撃的な脅威から、米国と共に軍を再建する従順な安全保障上のパートナーへと変わった」と述べた。

item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（18日） 4:30 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。鉱業や石油株の売り注文が優勢で、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は３日続落。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．１２％安だった。

ドル高と人工知能（ＡＩ）投資への懸念から銅価格が下落し、銅大手アントファガスタは７．９％安。資源大手のリオティント、グレンコア、アングロ・アメリカンは４．７─７．２％下落。金の値下がりを受けて、貴金属採掘フレスニヨは４．７％、エンデバー・マイニングは７．２％、いずれも下落した。

原油先物価格の下落を受けて、石油大手シェルは２．１％、ＢＰは３．０％、それぞれ下落した。

一方、人材紹介会社のヘイズは３８．９％高。２０２６年７─１２月期の営業利益見通しが市場予想を上回り、買いが膨らんだ。

１０月の英消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前年同月比３．６％上昇となり、９月の３．５％から上昇率が加速した。ただイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）の予測３．７％を下回り、市場での１２月の利上げ観測はいくぶん後退した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

３日続落して取引を終えた。資源や石油株が売られた。人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックによる大型の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を控え、投資家の様子見姿勢が強まり、域内の主要市場がいずれも下落した。

銅価格が下落したことを受け、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種資源株指数は４．６９％安。スイスの資源大手グレンコアは６．１％、ドイツの金属大手アウルビスは５．３％、それぞれ下落した。

原油先物の値下がりを受けて、石油・ガス株指数は２．１０％下落した。

テクノロジー株指数は０．３９％安。オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは１．９４％高。米半導体大手エヌビディアは１７日に市場予想を上回る売上高見通しを示したものの、ＡＩを巡る懸念は続いている。

減益決算となったフランスの鉄道車両大手アルストム＜ALSO.PA＞は７．２％安。ドイツのスポーツ用品大手プーマは競争激化への懸念から１．０％安だった。

ドイツ銀行は３．１％安と続落した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りがほぼ横ばいで推移した。市場では原油価格の下落と米金融当局者のタカ派的な発言が意識された。投資家は市場全体の心理を見極める手掛かりとして、アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）価格の決定を待っている。

ユーロ圏の指標となるドイツ１０年国債利回りは前日比小幅低下の３．３８％だった。

欧州の国債利回りはエネルギー価格に反応している。１８日は欧州の指標となる天然ガス価格と北海ブレント原油先物がともに下落した。

ただ、利回りの低下幅は限られた。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事がインフレに対するより積極的な対応を求めたことを受け、米国債と同様に欧州国債の利回りも影響を受けた。nL6N46Z13A

ＩＮＧのシニア金利ストラテジスト、ベンジャミン・シュローダー氏は「引き続きＡＩを巡る見方が焦点となっており、アンソロピックのＩＰＯは市場全体の心理を試す新たな機会となる」とした。

金融政策の見通しに敏感に反応するドイツ２年国債利回りは３．１２％と横ばいだった。

フランス１０年国債利回りは２ｂｐ低下の４．８７％だった。

今週は、２月７日に任期を待たずに退任するラガルドＥＣＢ総裁の後任人事も注目されている。

item.title: ＦＲＢ内でインフレ懸念強まる、ＡＩ投資リスクも警戒＝議事要旨
item.description:
Howard Schneider Michael S. Derby
[ワシントン／ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] -...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ内でインフレ懸念強まる、ＡＩ投資リスクも警戒＝議事要旨 4:25 配信

２００８年３月撮影　REUTERS/Jason Reed（ロイター） Howard Schneider　Michael S. Derby

[ワシントン／ニューヨーク　１８日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１８日に公表した１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）の議事要旨で、ＦＲＢ当局者が当面は政策金利を現行水準に据え置くことで一致したものの、インフレ抑制に向けた対応を一段と強化する必要に迫られるリスクが高まっているとの見方を示していたことが分かった。

議事要旨によると、「ほぼ全て」の参加者は、経済が想定通りに推移した場合、追加利上げが必要になるとの見方で一致。同時に、一部の参加者は、インフレが一段と根強くなり、現在の想定以上に「引き締め的な政策スタンスへの転換」が必要になる可能性があるとの認識を示した。さらに「２人程度」が、今後発表されるインフレ指標が好ましくない内容になれば、０．５％ポイントの利上げが必要になる可能性があると主張した。

ＦＲＢは１１月の中間選挙を目前に控えた１０月のＦＯＭＣでフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定。決定は１０対２で、クック理事とクリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁が２会合連続となる０．２５％ポイントの利上げを主張し、金利据え置きに反対票を投じた。

政策金利の据え置きに賛成票を投じた参加者のうち、「数人」は据え置きの決定が際どい判断だったとの認識を示した。また、より多くの参加者が、政策金利の据え置きについて、ＦＲＢの２％インフレ目標達成への取り組みが弱まったことを意味するものではないと明確に伝えるべきだと訴えた。インフレ率が目標水準に向けて十分なペースで鈍化しないとの懸念がＦＲＢ内で強まっていることが浮き彫りになった格好となる。

＜ＡＩ巨額投資を巡る懸念＞

１０月のＦＯＭＣでは、ＡＩ（人工知能）の影響についてこれまでより踏み込んだ議論が行われ、ＡＩ関連投資への過剰投資がもたらすリスクに加え、生産性向上などの恩恵をもたらす可能性についても取り上げられた。

議事要旨で、ＡＩへの積極的な投資や資産価格の高騰に伴う金融安定上のリスクがＦＲＢ当局者の警戒対象になっていることが判明。「（ＦＲＢ）スタッフは、足元の脆弱性で、通常以上にショックが増幅する可能性があると判断した。資産評価額の高さとヘッジファンドのレバレッジが最も顕著な脆弱性である一方、銀行や家計の健全なバランスシートが深刻な事態を和らげる重要な緩衝材になっている」と指摘した。

政策当局者は、ＡＩ技術への巨額投資が期待通りの成果を生まず、金融システムや実体経済に広範な影響を及ぼす可能性への懸念が明確に表明。議事要旨によると、「ほぼ全ての参加者」がＡＩ投資の収益が投資家の期待を下回るシナリオに伴うリスクについて言及したほか、「大半の参加者」がＡＩ関連債務が急速に増加しており、その多くが複雑で不透明な資金調達スキームを通じて積み上がっていると指摘。「一部の参加者」はＡＩ関連エクスポージャーが少数の企業に集中していることに懸念を示した。

＜ヘッジファンドにも警戒感＞

ＦＲＢ当局者らは、ヘッジファンドについても警戒を表明。議事要旨によると、「大半の参加者」はヘッジファンドのレバレッジや証券会社の市場仲介能力の不足が、市場混乱時にショックを増幅する経路となる可能性があると指摘した。

同時に、金融システムは「強靱（きょうじん）」だと評価。銀行は十分な流動性を確保しているとした。ただ、一部の参加者は、過去の事例を踏まえ、当初の評価が安心材料に見えた場合でも銀行システムの脆弱性が急速に表面化する可能性もあると警告。さらに一部の参加者は、ＦＲＢが把握している銀行の健全性データでは、一部の金融機関が抱えるリスクに対するエクスポージャーの全体像を十分に捉え切れていない可能性があるとの懸念も示した。

議事要旨で、ＦＲＢ当局者らが将来の金融不安にどう対応すべきかについて検討していたことも判明。「一部の参加者」は、銀行の自己資本を増強する案について議論したほか、ＦＲＢが長年取り組んできた課題として、銀行が緊急融資制度である公定歩合貸出制度（ディスカウントウインドー）をより円滑に利用できるよう準備を進めることが重要との認識を示した。さらに「一部」の参加者は、金融安定への懸念に明確に対応することを目的とした新たな戦略として、ＦＲＢが専用の資産購入枠組みを設ける案についても検討した。

＜バランスシート＞

ＦＲＢは、金融政策手段としてバランスシートを将来どのように活用していくかについて検討を進めている。ＦＲＢの資産保有額は、２００８年の世界金融危機や新型コロナウイルス禍の際に実施した大規模な国債購入により、この２０年余りで大幅に膨らんだ。

クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は、危機終息後の売却を含めた明確な枠組みの整備を支持する当局者の一人とされており、今週に入り「こうしたプログラムは一時的なものであるべきで、市場の金融安定が回復した後は保有資産を適時に売却する必要がある」と述べている。

議事要旨によると、「数人」の参加者が市場の混乱に対応する手段として金融政策を用いるのは適切ではないと警告。ただ、経済成長の原動力としてＡＩやテクノロジー投資が占める比重が大きくなっていることから、大規模な問題が発生した場合には、こうした見方が複雑化する可能性も指摘された。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/19(木) 6:21 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Fed policymakers focused on inflation risks in October, with some seeing need for bigger rate hike
item.description: Federal Reserve officials noted a greater risk of inflation requiring more action during their October meeting. Although they decided to keep interest rates steady, discussions indicated a potential need for a half-percentage-point increase. Policymakers expressed concerns over persistent inflation that might not ease quickly enough. The forthcoming December meeting could see intense debates on potential rate hikes and policy adjustments.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve officials saw a growing risk last month that they might need to intensify their efforts to control inflation, even as they agreed to keep interest rates steady for the moment, the minutes of their October 27-28 meeting showed on Wednesday. Almost all policymakers agreed that further rate hikes would be needed if the economy evolved as they expected, the minutes said, while a few said inflation could prove more persistent and require a shift to a more restrictive policy stance than currently expected. A couple of them went further and argued that the Fed might have to resort to a half-percentage-point increase if incoming inflation data were unfavorable, a benchmark met in recent releases that showed prices rising faster than anticipated.For live updates on US Markets, click hereAmong those who supported keeping the policy rate steady in the 3.75%-4.00% range in October, a few ... indicated that they viewed the decision as a close call, and joined a larger group in urging that the Fed be clear that the decision to maintain the target range did not reflect a weakening of the commitment to hit the US central bank's 2% inflation target.At the end of the two-day session, only Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissented in favor of lifting the policy rate by a quarter of a percentage point.But the debate highlighted a growing sense at the Fed that inflation will not ease enough on its own for the target to be reached quickly enough. Among those supporting a rate-hike pause, the hope is that coming information will make clearer whether inflation can fall without tighter policy.Prices have been increasing at more than a 3% annual rate, and there has been little improvement in recent months.Last month's meeting also set the stage for a potentially intense debate at the December 8-9 session over the need for a larger rate hike, or at least tougher language about the extent and pace of rate hikes to come, an argument laid out by Fed Governor Christopher Waller in comments to CNBC on Wednesday.The Trump administration has argued that elevated inflation is just temporary and the Fed should ignore it.Inflation has been stronger than expected since the Fed's last meeting, and investors anticipate that the central bank will deliver a quarter-percentage-point rate increase at its meeting next month.The October meeting also saw the beginnings of a more detailed discussion about the impact of artificial intelligence, including discussion of the risks of over-investment in the technology as well as the possible benefits it could bring in the form of rising productivity.

item.title: Indonesian miners scramble for clarity as Prabowo seeks greater state share
item.description: Miners in Indonesia, the world’s biggest exporter of thermal coal, nickel and tin, are scrambling to decipher President Prabowo Subianto’s call for the st
item.dc:creator: Mining.com
item.content:encoded: Miners in Indonesia, the world’s biggest exporter of thermal coal, nickel and tin, are scrambling to decipher President Prabowo Subianto’s call for the state to secure greater benefits from mining operations, warning that the uncertainty could deter investment in the resource-rich nation. The comments add to concerns among investors over policy uncertainty in Southeast Asia’s largest economy – home to the world’s largest gold mine and the biggest known nickel reserves – which has already been rattled by warnings from international credit ratings agencies and the prospect of MSCI excluding the country from its stock market indexes. Indonesia’s energy stock index .JKENERGY, which includes shares of coal miners, has dropped 4.1% since Prabowo’s weekend comments – while the basic materials stock index .JKBASIC, which covers miners of other minerals, has lost 6.2%. Prabowo, speaking on Saturday, said he had instructed ministers to ensure the state receives at least “70% of the benefits from all mining permits” and added that, if necessary, the state should “take over stakes” in companies in Indonesia. The president did not spell out what constituted “benefits” or how the 70% would be calculated, leaving miners and analysts trying to assess whether he was referring to profits, revenue, taxes and royalties, or a broader measure of the state’s economic benefit. “We are still examining what President Prabowo meant by his intention for 70% of mining sector proceeds to go into state coffers,” Sudirman Widhy Hartono, chairman of the Association of Mining Professionals, told Reuters. He said the industry was awaiting a more detailed explanation from the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources. The ministry did not respond to a request from Reuters for comment. A spokesperson for the president did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The mining sector, especially in nickel and coal, is already struggling with tighter production quotas and rising costs. French miner Eramet, which was forced to halt operations for several months due to a lower mining quota, is planning to sell some stake in its Indonesian nickel mine. “The mere uncertainty surrounding definitions is enough to delay new investment decisions,” said Fauzan Luthfi Djamal, mining analyst with brokerage Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia. “Foreign partners involved in nickel downstreaming are likely re-evaluating project returns, while financing costs could potentially rise.” Mineral-rich Indonesia had seen massive investment in its nickel processing sector following a raw nickel export ban in 2020, and a similar ban on other minerals in 2023. Impact on companies Fauzan said the state’s objective of increasing revenue from natural resources is “understandable” but the challenge is designing a scheme that captures windfall gains without stifling business or deterring new investment. Sudirman said data from coal mining companies showed total state revenue can reach around 32% of total sales, while companies earn profits of less than 10% – which means government revenue is more than three times company profit. Depending on how the 70% “benefit” is calculated, Fauzan estimated net profits for privately owned miners could be cut by as much as half, while mines operating under special mining licences could see profits fall by up to a third. Fauzan said the quickest route would probably be through higher royalties, with the government having previously considered increases for gold, copper, silver, nickel and tin. Other possibilities include additional levies or requiring state equity participation when mining licences are extended or converted. Indonesia had earlier this year shelved plans to impose windfall taxes on coal and nickel exports and increase royalties on some mining companies. In May, Prabowo said exports of coal, palm oil and ferroalloys would be controlled by state-run Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia to combat exports being under-invoiced. The proposal was subsequently scaled back, with the agency saying its initial role would be as a centralised data collector. In August, Prabowo also announced a commodities exchange and said Indonesia should set its own prices rather than follow global benchmarks. “Prabowo often issues directives,” said Bhima Yudhistira Adhinegara, an economist at the Center of Economics and Law Studies think tank. “Yet the technical regulations are never prepared beforehand … we’re seeing this happen again.” (Reporting by Fransiska Nangoy and Bernadette Christina; Writing by Gibran Peshimam; Editing by Raju Gopalakrishnan)

item.title: イスラエル情報機関長官が先週訪米、イラン共同攻撃を働きかけ＝関係筋
item.description:
Alexander Cornwell
[エルサレム １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Cornwell

[エルサレム １８日 ロイター] - イスラエル情報機関モサドのゴフマン長官が先週、米当局者との会談で、イランに対する米国とイスラエルの共同攻撃を働きかけたことが関係筋２人の話で分かった。

関係筋によると、ゴフマン氏はワシントンでラトクリフ中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）長官を含むトランプ政権の高官と会談し、イランに関するイスラエルの情報分析について説明した。イスラエルメディアによると、ゴフマン氏はフロリダ州マイアミも訪れ、ウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使と会談した。同特使はイランやウクライナを巡る米外交を担当している。

今回の訪米に先立ち、トランプ大統領は今月９日、イランに対する新たな軍事攻撃を当面見送る方針を表明。ホワイトハウスで会談したカタール首相を含め、域内諸国から要請を受けたと説明した。カタールは全面的な戦闘再開の回避を目的とした米国とイランの間接協議の仲介役を務めている。

モサドに関する報道対応を担うイスラエル首相府はコメントの要請に応じていない。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、トランプ氏は米国の経済的な圧力作戦がイランにとって「壊滅的」であるため、「大規模な戦闘作戦」の必要はないと考えていると述べた。ただ、イランに核兵器を決して保有させないため、トランプ氏にはあらゆる選択肢があるとした。ゴフマン氏とラトクリフ氏の会談についてはコメントしなかった。ＣＩＡもコメントを控えた。

＜ネタニヤフ氏、攻撃の機会は狭まりつつあると認識＞

関係筋２人によると、ゴフマン氏は会談でイスラエルの対イラン情報を説明。このうち１人によると、その中には米・イラン外交の焦点になっているイランの核開発計画に関する情報も含まれていた。

２人によると、ゴフマン氏の訪米とほぼ同時期に、ネタニヤフ氏の側近で元閣僚のデルメル氏も米国を訪れ、トランプ政権当局者との会談で共同攻撃を働きかけた。

ネタニヤフ氏は、攻撃に踏み切る機会が狭まりつつあると考えているという。関係筋の１人によると、イスラエルは米国が年内に中東に展開する大規模な部隊の縮小を始める可能性を懸念している。

関係筋２人はゴフマン氏とデルメル氏による米当局者への働きかけについて、イランへの新たな攻撃に踏み切るようトランプ氏を説得するネタニヤフ氏の取り組みの一環だと述べた。

イスラエル軍は、イランがイスラエルに差し迫った脅威をもたらしてはおらず、即時の軍事行動は必要ないと分析しているという。イスラエル軍はコメント要請に応じていない。

item.title: 追加利上げ適切となる可能性、経済が予想通り推移なら＝バーＦＲＢ理事
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備制度理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
追加利上げ適切となる可能性、経済が予想通り推移なら＝バーＦＲＢ理事 3:56 配信

バーＦＲＢ理事。2月17日、ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo（ロイター） Michael S. Derby

[ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備制度理事会（ＦＲＢ）のバー理事は１８日、経済が予想通り推移すれば、「さらなる利上げが適切になるだろう」と述べた。

バー理事は講演原稿で、「インフレは高すぎる」ため、多くの家計が物価上昇の重圧にさらされているとし、ＦＲＢがインフレを２％に向けて「適時」に引き下げることが極めて重要だとの認識を示した。

また、インフレは課題ではあるものの、経済は好調と指摘。「経済は堅調で、失業率は低く、個人消費は底堅く、企業投資も活発だ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：「永久先物」に揺れる米金融街、新たなリスク警戒　政権が導入推進 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/19(木) 5:51 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 18 : US women's national team coach Emma Hayes will rely on veteran players to guide the team during their World Cup qualifying campaign this month, with a coveted direct ticket to Brazil on the line. Hayes on Wednesday named her 23-player squad for the upcoming CONCACAF W Championship, where a quarter-final win against El Salvador on November 27 would secure their qualification to next year’s World Cup.  Leading the Americans is the dynamic attacking trio of Trinity Rodman, Mallory Swanson and Sophia Wilson, with midfielder Sam Coffey also returning to the fold after missing the previous two windows through injury. "Qualifying for a major tournament, first and foremost, I'll be leaning on our experienced players,” Hayes said on a media call. “They know how to do this, and they've been with us the longest to be able to deliver that.

“And I think for the less-experienced players, they've had a good body of work in the last couple of years. We know what we need to do. We need to just make sure we come into camp with a really clear mind about those things.” NEW-LOOK BACKLINE Among the fresh faces in the backline are Kate Del Fava, who has one cap, as well as Evelyn Shores, who has yet to make her senior national-team debut. Their call-ups come in the absence of injured veterans Naomi Girma and Emily Sonnett. “I think there's no denying if Emily Sonnett and Naomi Girma were fit, maybe that wouldn't have happened,” Hayes said of Del Fava's call-up. “But I do think that maintaining that depth is important, and sometimes players come in the back door, even late, and I think she's someone who's fully deserving of being with us.” Still, Hayes acknowledged the challenges that absences present when a team is trying to build chemistry, saying, “In an ideal world, we have all of our top players available so we can build connections together.” DEMANDING CONSISTENCY Claudia Dickey, Mandy McGlynn and Phallon Tullis-Joyce are competing to start in goal following Alyssa Naeher’s retirement in 2024. “It's just a work in progress, unfortunately. That's what development looks like,” Hayes said. “And I think for all three of the keepers, that is probably what I want more of from all of them, consistency in their performances.” Her demand for consistency is not limited to the goalkeepers, though. Having “credit in the bank” does help a player, but it may not guarantee a place in the squad every time.   “I will be unafraid to leave anybody off that plane if I don't feel that they are applying themselves to put (us) in the best possible position to compete,” Hayes said. “This upcoming camp, our job is to qualify for the World Cup. And so, everything we have worked towards is ensuring that every player that comes into camp makes sure they lift their level and they position the team to have the most positive outcome.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: GTA VI frenzy spotlights potential insurance risks lurking in digital infrastructure
item.description: Nov 18 : Millions of gamers around the world have logged on for the launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI," arguably the century's most anticipated video game, offering a glimpse of the vast, interconnected digital infrastructure the global economy increasingly relies on.No major disruption is expected from the roll

GTA VI frenzy spotlights potential insurance risks lurking in digital infrastructure

FAST

Nov 18 : Millions of gamers around the world have logged on for the launch of "Grand Theft Auto VI," arguably the century's most anticipated video game, offering a glimpse of the vast, interconnected digital infrastructure the global economy increasingly relies on. No major disruption is expected from the rollout. But the scale of demand around one of the gaming industry's biggest releases underscores a broader risk for insurers: a failure at a shared cloud, payments or technology provider could affect thousands of businesses at once. After 13 years in development and an estimated $1 billion or more in production costs, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' began rolling out globally on Thursday, drawing the kind of attention that few entertainment releases ever command. But the fervour also underscores how much modern businesses depend on the digital infrastructure that makes such mass online activity possible, and the risks insurers face when that infrastructure fails.

"A launch of the scale of GTA VI is effectively a built-in stress test of the shared digital economy infrastructure," said Marcos Alvarez, managing director at Morningstar DBRS. Insurers cover businesses against financial losses stemming from disruptions to their operations, including some caused by technology failures. As companies increasingly rely on the same cloud providers, payment systems and digital platforms, a single outage could trigger claims from multiple policyholders at once, amplifying exposure. Despite the frenzy surrounding the launch, any disruption on launch day or in the days that follow would not necessarily spell disaster for insurers, industry experts said. "The recent technology outages have been a case in point with the gap between the economic cost and the actual insured loss being quite large due to policy limits, retentions, waiting periods, and coverage exclusions," Alvarez added. Business interruption could be a major source of claims, but coverage could also extend to costs associated with data recovery, system restoration, cyberattacks and outages at third-party technology providers, depending on the policy. "This is an area that is evolving rapidly for the insurance industry. Insurers are refining how they assess, model and manage these interconnected exposures," said Loretta Worters, a spokesperson for the Insurance Information Institute. "That means looking beyond an individual company's cybersecurity protections to understand its reliance on third-party providers, the concentration of those dependencies across their portfolios and the potential for a single event to generate losses across multiple policyholders."

Source: Reuters

item.title: イランの脅威「大幅増大」、国内外の米国人にリスク＝国家情報長官
item.description: [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] -  クレイトン米国家情報長官は１８日、議会下院国土安全保障委員会の公聴会で、イランの米国人に対する脅威が大幅に高まっていると述べた。

クレイトン氏はで「国内外でイランによる殺害を目的とした陰謀を検知し、抑止し、対処することに引き続き全力を尽くしている」とし、「こうした脅威は大幅に増大している。国内外の米国人はこれまで以上に大きな脅威にさらされている」と述べた。

イランは現在も続く米軍の攻撃に対する報復として米軍や地域の同盟国を攻撃すると警告。ロイターが先月確認したメモによると、クレイトン氏は、イランが米国人職員を標的とする活動を強化しており、イランによる米国人に対する殺害計画は「高度な段階」に達していると指摘していた。

こうした中、米ＣＮＮは今週に入り、イランが米首都ワシントンで放射性物質を飛散させる「ダーティーボム（汚い爆弾）」による攻撃を計画している可能性があると米情報機関の情報として報道。クレイトン氏は公聴会でこの報道について質問された際、個別事案への言及は避け、民間人に対する大量破壊の脅威は長年にわたり存在していると述べるにとどめた。

item.title: アンソロピック株オプション、早ければ23日に取引開始へ 旺盛な需要見込む

item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック株オプション、早ければ23日に取引開始へ　旺盛な需要見込む 3:22 配信

米アンソロピックのロゴ。11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Laura Matthews

[ニューヨーク １８日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピック株のオプション取引が、早ければ２３日にも開始される可能性がある。市場関係者が旺盛な需要を見込む中、同社の先行きに賭ける新たな手段になるとみられる。

取引所運営会社Ｃｂｏｅグローバル・マーケッツは、業界の準備状況次第では、株式の取引開始から２営業日後にオプション取引を上場する見通しだ。同社のデリバティブ部門グローバル責任者、ロブ・ホッキング氏は「アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）は新たな起爆剤となり、オプション市場に新しい投資家層と取引を呼び込む可能性がある」とし、「オプションによってリスクをどのように管理できるかをより多くの人々が理解し、投資家教育がこの成長をけん引しているのを見るのは素晴らしいことだ。このトレンドは今後も続くと予想している」と述べた。

オプションメトリックスのギャレット・デシモーネ氏は「アンソロピックのオプションが上場すれば、相当な関心が集まると予想している」と指摘。「ＡＩを巡る熱狂と、ＩＰＯに典型的な宝くじのようなリターンプロファイルが相まって、即座に投資家を惹きつけるだろう。ＡＩに最も純度の高い形で集中投資できる対象の一つとして、株価は非常に変動しやすくなる可能性も高い」との見方を示した。

アンソロピックは、１８日にＩＰＯの公開価格を決定する見通しで、株式は１９日にナスダックで取引が始まる。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Texas has resumed issuing air permits for data centers, state regulators said on Wednesday, after pausing the practice last month as part of the state's broader attempt to manage the server warehouses and their effects on the electrical grid, communities and the environment. • The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality "has resumed its normal permit review process and will evaluate applications under all applicable state and federal laws and regulations," TCEQ spokesperson Laura Lopez said. • Texas Governor Greg Abbott halted the connection of new data centers to the state electric grid in August and ordered an audit of the projects, rattling one of the world's fastest-growing hubs for data center development. Abbott followed up by temporarily blocking air permits for all data center projects. • The air permit resumption came after the Texas grid operator notified the TCEQ that it had collected "community impact review" information for proposed data center projects, Lopez said.

• Abbott, a Republican, lost his reelection bid in this month's midterm elections to Democratic challenger Gina Hinojosa, who has promised to impose a moratorium on data centers once in office in January. • The most recent permitting decision may generate more pushback from incoming Texas Democratic lawmakers and politicians in the new year, analysts said. • "TD Cowen sees Abbott's lame duck permitting push as likely to strengthen the Dem-stakeholder demand that Hinojosa take a firm stand, reducing hopes for a near-term policy agreement between Hinojosa and data center developers," the firm said in a note.

Source: Reuters

item.description: PARIS/NEW YORK, Nov 18 : An Abu Dhabi court has ordered several major cryptocurrency companies to freeze digital assets worth billions of dollars as part of efforts to recover some of the $6.3 billion in tokens stolen from wallets operated by Binance, according to court documents seen by Reuters.The Abu Dhabi

FAST

PARIS/NEW YORK, Nov 18 : An Abu Dhabi court has ordered several major cryptocurrency companies to freeze digital assets worth billions of dollars as part of efforts to recover some of the $6.3 billion in tokens stolen from wallets operated by Binance, according to court documents seen by Reuters. The Abu Dhabi Global Market Court decision seeks to prevent the stolen crypto from being moved and applies to companies including Circle and World Liberty Financial. The court said the 18 named companies were not accused of wrongdoing. Many companies have already frozen tokens that were stolen from Binance on October 29 in the largest crypto heist on record. US authorities have attributed the attack to North Korea. “We will continue using every lawful tool available to trace, freeze and recover stolen assets, support our partners in returning funds where possible, and keep those assets out of the hands of the attackers,” Dugan Bliss, deputy general counsel at Binance, said in a statement on Wednesday.

The Abu Dhabi Global Market financial center serves as Binance's global hub, and the company said the Financial Services Regulatory Authority there is its primary regulator. Reuters was the first to report that Binance was granted a court order to aid asset recovery. Binance subsequently said in a blog post on Wednesday that, while it had absorbed the financial impact of the stolen funds and made customers whole, it had a responsibility to pursue the stolen assets and support law enforcement.  BILLIONS ALREADY FROZEN Binance has previously said that around $2.85 billion worth of the stolen crypto tokens had been frozen or intercepted by third parties. That includes Circle, which operates the stablecoin USDC, and World Liberty Financial, the crypto venture operated by US President Donald Trump's family, which has a stablecoin called USD1. Both tokens are pegged to the US dollar.  Under the court order, those firms and 16 others are required to maintain the freeze on the tokens involved in the heist, pending further court proceedings. They are also barred from lending, swapping or mixing the tokens with other assets.  El Salvador-based Tether, which issues the USDT token and previously said it had frozen $1.5 billion worth of the stolen funds, was not included in the court order. Bliss said Binance was working with Tether directly on the return of the frozen assets. "In consultation with the relevant authorities, we will work directly with Binance in respect of reissuing the tokens," a spokesperson for Tether said. Binance has hired US law firm Gibson Dunn as part of its efforts to recover the stolen crypto. In a statement, a lawyer from Gibson Dunn representing Binance called the injunction "one of, if not the, largest publicly known freezing orders ever made." FURTHER HEARING SCHEDULED A further hearing is scheduled for December 1, when the court will consider whether the proprietary injunction — a freezing order that applies to claimed assets — should continue and on what terms.  David Wachsman, spokesman for World Liberty Financial, said: "As the security incident unfolded in real time, World Liberty received an alert from onchain data identifying the issue. We acted decisively to protect our users and our partners." In a statement, a spokesperson for Circle said the company continues to coordinate with Binance and law enforcement, adding that Circle does not comment on specific legal proceedings.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Hyperliquid Pushes for 7 Key Tweaks Ahead of UK’s 2027 Crypto Overhaul
item.description: The Hyperliquid Policy Center (HPC) sent a letter to the UK Financial Conduct Authority CAPITALCOM:FCA on Nov. 18 with seven recommendations on the draft documents CP26/36 and GC26/7. Three of them ...
item.content:encoded:
News / U.Today / Hyperliquid Pushes for 7 Key Tweaks Ahead of UK’s 2027 Crypto Overhaul

Hyperliquid Pushes for 7 Key Tweaks Ahead of UK’s 2027 Crypto Overhaul 1 min read

F FCA The Hyperliquid Policy Center (HPC) sent a letter to the UK Financial Conduct Authority F FCA on Nov. 18 with seven recommendations on the draft documents CP26/36 and GC26/7. Three of them concern CP26/36, and four concern GC26/7. The letter was signed by HPC chief executive Jake Chervinsky. The UK's new crypto regime will start to apply on Oct. 25, 2027. The FCA opened its window for crypto license applications on Sept. 30, 2026, and the window will close on Feb. 28, 2027. According to the letter, "Regulatory obligations belong with persons who have unilateral control over a function that is a regulated activity." HPC argued that attaching obligations to a person who could not discharge them "would offer consumers no additional protection." In the letter, HPC also compared  public blockchains with the internet. "Like a public blockchain, the internet depends on protocols that identifiable persons maintain and upgrade over time," the group wrote. HPC asked the FCA to assess each participant in a blockchain network separately. Proprietary traders and market makers "supply much of the liquidity on which order books depend," the group wrote. HPC also asked the regulator to describe  compliance requirements as outcomes and to hold regulated firms accountable for them. HPC's earlier letters to regulators On Aug. 24, HPC urged the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to harmonize their rules for perpetual contracts. The group argued that such products should be classified by their economic structure. According to HPC, a harmonized framework would let exchanges compete on "execution quality and liquidity." On Sept. 30, HPC sent its response to the European Union's review of the MiCA rules. In it, the group asked the EU to treat crypto perpetual futures as derivatives under MiFID II. "Clarity in application, rather than new legislation, is what would assist in regulating perpetual futures," HPC wrote at the time. Chervinsky previously served as chief policy officer at the Blockchain Association and as chief legal officer at the crypto venture firm Variant.

item.title: Nvidia raises sales outlook, says business can thrive without Huang
item.description: Nvidia raised its next fiscal year's revenue growth forecast to 75% and announced a $150 billion stock buyback expansion as interim CEO Colette Kress sought to reassure investors.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Nvidia Corp sought to deliver a clear message during its first earnings update since the departure of longtime leader Jensen Huang: He is not coming back, and the company will be fine without him. The chip giant boosted its sales forecast for next year and vowed to improve its access to critical supplies, while tamping down speculation that Huang might return. The company also added $150 billion to its stock buyback programme. Investors initially applauded the news, sending the stock up as much as 5.4 per cent at one point. It later dipped into the red on alternative trading platform Blue Ocean. “Our supply is growing, our customers and our partners are with us, and employees are committed,” interim Chief Executive Officer Colette Kress said during a conference call with analysts on Tuesday. “We’ve got this.” It was a high-stakes moment for Kress, who took the reins last week after Huang’s ouster — a chaotic exit reportedly spurred by multiple extramarital affairs and concerns that he was targeted by a Chinese espionage plot. Nvidia has been the largest beneficiary of the artificial intelligence (AI) build-out, and Huang served as the industry’s biggest cheerleader. Now the company looks to ensure that its momentum will not be undermined by the controversy swirling around it. Revenue will grow 75 per cent in the next fiscal year, Nvidia said, up from a previous forecast of 70 per cent. Sales will be $130 billion in the fiscal fourth quarter, plus or minus 3 per cent. Analysts had estimated $125.3 billion on average. “It’s business as usual,” said Kress, who has been Nvidia’s chief financial officer for more than a decade. “We’ve engaged with our customers. We’ve engaged with our suppliers, our partners. They’re all 100 per cent behind us.” Nvidia has embarked on a search for a new permanent CEO. During the call, Chairman Harvey Jones dismissed the idea that Huang might return. “The Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO,” he said, adding that executive search firm Heidrick & Struggles had been enlisted to find a new leader. Nvidia also said it would no longer ship its licensed Hopper data centre products to China, although the company had been allowed to offer those older-generation components under US export rules. At the firm's data centre division — its biggest source of revenue — sales more than doubled to $107.6 billion in the third quarter, which ended October 25. Total sales rose 103 per cent to $115.8 billion in the same period. Meanwhile, China's military is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons as Chinese-made processors continue to lag US rivals, a congressional commission said in its annual report released on Wednesday.

item.title: Intuit Stocks Fall 7.17% Two Days Before Earnings as AI Finance Tools Loom
item.description: INTU dropped 7.17% to $320.79 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 17 as the software selloff collided with worries that AI assistants could take over personal finance tasks. Startup Fortune linked ...
item.content:encoded:
News / GuruFocus / Intuit Stocks Fall 7.17% Two Days Before Earnings as AI Finance Tools Loom

Intuit Stocks Fall 7.17% Two Days Before Earnings as AI Finance Tools Loom Less than 1 min read

INTU Intuit INTU dropped 7.17% to $320.79 at the 4:00 p.m. ET close on November 17 as the software selloff collided with worries that AI assistants could take over personal finance tasks. Startup Fortune linked the pressure to Anthropic's Personal Finance in Claude beta, which lets users connect bank accounts and query two years of transactions. Intuit reports fiscal first-quarter results on November 19 after the close. Its own guidance calls for revenue of $4.294 billion to $4.313 billion, up 11%, and non-GAAP EPS of $2.44 to $2.48. For fiscal 2027, the company expects revenue growth of only 9% to 10% after 14% in fiscal 2026, alongside non-GAAP EPS of $22.88 to $23.12, with TurboTax revenue having grown just 7% last year.

The midpoint EPS guide puts the shares at about 13.9 times forward earnings, a multiple that already assumes slower growth. GuruFocus gives Intuit a GF Score of 81/100, combining elite profitability with badly broken momentum. Its GF Value of $840.52 puts the close about 62% below the model, a significantly undervalued reading that likely reflects years of premium multiples the market no longer grants. Thursday's report is the immediate test: a beat with steady fiscal 2027 guidance could ease disruption fears, while any cut would validate them.

item.description:
Anhata Rooprai Shashwat Chauhan
[１８日 ロイター] - １８日の米株式市場で、エヌビ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
エヌビディア株2％超下落、好業績見通しも経営混乱への懸念続く 2:26 配信

2025年1月27日に撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） Anhata Rooprai　Shashwat Chauhan

[１８日 ロイター] - １８日の米株式市場で、エヌビディア株が取引開始前の上昇から一転、２％超下落し、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の一角を押し下げた。前日発表された好業績見通しを受けた当初の安心感が薄れる一方、共同創業者ジェンスン・フアン氏の突然の退任に伴う不透明感が続いている。

エヌビディア株は取引開始前に一時３％上昇したが、午前の市場では２％以上下落した。このまま取引を終えれば、時価総額は８００億ドル余り減少する見通し。

１０月に付けた最高値から１７日の終値までに、既に約２兆ドルが失われている。

カウンターポイントの調査担当バイスプレジデント、ニール・シャー氏は「昨日の決算は投資家心理を安定させ、最近のＡＩ関連株の売りに歯止めをかけたと考えている。ただ、投資家の不安を根本的に解消したのではなく、先送りしたにすぎない」と述べた。

エヌビディアでは最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の選定と独立調査が続いているほか、米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）も同社を調査していると米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルが報じており、ＡＩ関連株全体の投資家心理を圧迫している。

エヌビディアのハーベイ・ジョーンズ会長は、フアン氏復帰の可能性を否定した。人材紹介会社ハイドリック・アンド・ストラグルズが、社内外の候補から正式なＣＥＯを選ぶ作業を主導している。

ＨＳＢＣのアナリストは、正式なＣＥＯが決まり、新経営陣が計画通りに製品を投入できると示すまでは、株価の一段の上昇は難しい可能性があると指摘した。

エヌビディアは１７日、２０２７年度第４・四半期（２０２６年１１月─２７年１月）の売上高が市場予想を上回るとの見通しを示した。第３・四半期（８─１０月）の売上高も前年の２倍超となり市場予想を上回った。

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 18 : Options on Anthropic shares could begin trading as soon as Monday, giving investors a new way to wager on the AI company's prospects as market participants expect heavy interest. Cboe Global Markets expects to list the contracts two business days after the stock begins trading, pending industry readiness. “The Anthropic IPO could be yet another catalyst, bringing a new wave of investors and trading activity to the options market," said Rob Hocking, Cboe’s global head of derivatives. "It’s great to see investor education driving this growth, as more people learn how options let them define their risk. An exciting trend and one we expect to continue.”  The Claude developer is expected to price its IPO later on Wednesday, and the shares will begin trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday.   "We expect significant interest in Anthropic options once they list," said Garrett DeSimone, head quant at OptionMetrics. "The combination of AI-driven enthusiasm and the lottery-like payoff profile typical of IPOs are likely to draw investors immediately. As one of the most concentrated pure-play exposures to AI, the stock is also likely to be highly volatile."

Interest in Anthropic options could exceed the interest in SpaceX options earlier this year, said Ophir Gottlieb, chief executive of Capital Market Laboratories, citing oversubscription that is pushing the company's valuation higher and could invite various positioning ahead of the deal, as well as the market backdrop. "The AI trade is melting down," Gottlieb said. "Many feel it is overdone, while many others feel it's the popping of a bubble. Whenever there is such opposing views in a heated market, we get a lot of option positioning." Options give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell shares at a set price within a certain period. They offer investors a cheaper way to gain exposure to a stock and to express their views on both short-term price moves and longer-term positioning. Anthropic’s $64 billion IPO has drawn stronger early institutional demand than the offering of SpaceX, with the book six times oversubscribed last week, Reuters previously reported. The IPO has drawn anticipation from investors, with Wall Street rolling out products tied to the stock, hosting client events and giving away merchandise ahead of the AI company's potentially record launch.

item.title: Surge in software patches likely behind recent tech outages, experts say

Surge in software patches likely behind recent tech outages, experts say

Microsoft Outlook logo and words "Global Outage" in this illustration taken on November 13, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

19 Nov 2026 01:11AM (Updated: 19 Nov 2026 06:39AM)

FAST

Nov 18 : While the causes of recent disruptions to the way people work, access bank accounts and travel remain unclear, increased efforts to rapidly patch newly discovered vulnerabilities in the AI age are likely a major factor, according to cybersecurity experts and US officials. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, speaking to reporters in Manila this week, said company patching efforts are, at times, "creating short-term disruption in the way the system works." Patches are software and operating system updates intended to fix security vulnerabilities found within a program or product. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton told a House of Representatives Homeland Security Committee hearing on worldwide threats Wednesday that there is so far no indication that the tech outages are related. But Clayton said the speed and level of capability of computer systems are "increasing substantially," so legacy computer systems and equipment that already were old are aging much more quickly.

The advent of easily accessible AI tools and large language models has supercharged the discovery of vulnerabilities in software. Microsoft this month has addressed more than 1,200 software vulnerabilities, nearly 20 times higher than in the same month a year ago, according to cybersecurity firm Qualys. At least one major bank was rushing to address a wave of recent patches and there is a lot of work needed, a source at the bank said, speaking on condition of anonymity.  "AI has made finding critical vulnerabilities fast and cheap, and the number of flaws that demand immediate patching has grown with it," said Yuval Itzchakov, CTO and co-founder of autonomous offensive security company A Security.  "Emergency patches go into core infrastructure within hours, often without the full testing cycle, and they are intrusive by design: they change runtimes, kernels and network components that everything else depends on. That speed and scale of change is itself a source of failure," Itzchakov said. Josh Bressers, director of coordinated vulnerability disclosure at cybersecurity firm VulnCheck, said that in 2026 there have been 100,000 publicly disclosed vulnerabilities, tracked by industry as Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures, or CVEs. Of those, Bressers said, 1,363 were known to have been exploited in the real world.  "Given tight resources for defenders, understanding which vulnerabilities need attention first is critical," Bressers wrote in a LinkedIn post. "Not all vulnerabilities are created equal." Anne Neuberger, general partner at Andreessen Horowitz, said that AI is helping attackers find and weaponize vulnerabilities, but is a more "valuable friend" to those tasked with defending key computer networks. "AI is enabling enterprises to find 10 times more vulnerabilities," said Neuberger, who served as deputy national security adviser under former President Joe Biden and led incident response to serious national incidents. "And when patching at scale, some can cause problems." Ronald Gestiehr, director of wealth management at Luttner Financial, said technology has made banking "incredibly convenient, and while occasional outages can be frustrating I don't believe the outages will have a significant impact on consumer confidence or change how most people manage their money."  "Financial institutions have invested heavily in technology and security, and, unfortunately, occasional disruptions will happen," Gestiehr said. "What matters most is how quickly those issues are identified, resolved and communicated to customers."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Copper price craters as AI, tariff trades unwind, wiping $186 billion off top producers in a month
item.description: Stan Druckenmiller has gone short and Asia Copper Week heard that demand is ‘recessionary-like’, yet Chinese buyers are paying a record premium for prompt metal.
item.dc:creator: Frik Els
item.content:encoded:
Copper price craters as AI, tariff trades unwind, wiping $186 billion off top producers in a month

Staff Writer | November 18, 2026 | 8:58 am Markets   China   Latin America   United States   Copper

Credit: Adobe Stock

Copper plunged to its lowest since April on Wednesday as speculators abandoned bets tied to the artificial intelligence boom, a surging dollar and fading US tariff prospects overwhelmed signs of acute physical shortage in China, and the loss of key chart levels added to momentum selling, dragging shares of the biggest producers down by between 5% and 9%.

Comex copper for December delivery, the most active contract in New York, fell as much as 6.7% to $5.5835 a pound ($12,309 a tonne) in late morning trade, the lowest since early April, and more than 82,000 contracts had changed hands by midday. The contract has fallen for five sessions in a row and at the day’s low was down 16% in three weeks and 19% below the record settlement of $6.8885 reached on September 9. A gain for 2026 that stood at 22% at the peak has been wiped out, with the price dipping below where it ended last year.

On the London Metal Exchange, three-month copper was down 3.4% at $12,772.50 a tonne in official trading and later extended its loss to as much as 5.6%, the lowest since April, Bloomberg reports. In Shanghai the most-traded contract shed 3.4% to 97,920 yuan ($14,690) a tonne, and tin, the other metal most closely tied to AI hardware, slumped more than 7% in London to its lowest in almost eight months.

Underlying consumption is not helping either. “Copper demand today is closer to a recessionary-like environment than growth environment,” Nicholas Snowdon, head of metals and mining research at Mercuria, told the World Copper Conference Asia in Shanghai on Wednesday, according to Bloomberg. Natixis analysts have described the combination of US stockpiling and AI-linked investment flows as a bubble, while banks remain split on whether 2027 brings shortage or surplus .

Miners routed

The selling spread to equities as the session wore on. Eleven of the largest copper-exposed miners lost a combined $49 billion, or more than 6% of their market value, by early afternoon in New York, taking their losses to $112 billion over the past week and $186 billion, or 20%, over the past month.

BHP dropped 6.5% to a market value of $178 billion, $32 billion less than a month ago and well under the $207 billion it was worth during last week’s short-lived bounce . Southern Copper has been hit hardest among the majors, down 5.2% on the day and 26% in a month to $125 billion, a loss of $45 billion that has cut its 2026 gain to 6% from 41% in mid-October. Freeport-McMoRan, worth about $100 billion a month ago, fell 6.7% to $74 billion and is barely positive for the year.

Rio Tinto lost 5.1% to $130 billion and Glencore 6.5% to $72 billion, while Anglo American fell 8.0% and Teck Resources 7.4%. Antofagasta and Lundin Mining were the day’s worst performers among the larger names, both down more than 9%, and along with Rio are now in negative territory for 2026.

First Quantum Minerals, which jumped on Tuesday after Panama opened formal talks on restarting Cobre Panama , fell 5.5% and is 23% lower over the month. Ivanhoe Mines has shed 34% in a month and 58% in 2026.

Towel thrown in

Investors appear to be giving up after the loss of several technical levels added to momentum selling, Ole Hansen, head of commodity strategy at Saxo Bank, told Reuters, pointing to an inflation scare and the risk of higher funding costs. “AI was a trigger, but it’s not really the driver,” he said.

Ryan McKay, senior commodity strategist at TD Securities, described the move to Bloomberg as a complete recalibration of the copper market: worries about Federal Reserve tightening are weighing on the demand outlook, the midterm results have dented optimism about AI spending, and the New York premium over London, a proxy for tariff expectations, is narrowing. Speculative positioning has largely unwound and in places flipped net short, while selling by trend-following funds has accelerated the decline, McKay said.

Tech stocks steadied on Wednesday after Nvidia reported a 103% jump in quarterly revenue to $115.8 billion late on Tuesday, the chipmaker’s first results since Jensen Huang’s exit rattled the metals demand story , but that did nothing for copper. The dollar is holding near a 19-month high ahead of the release of minutes from the Federal Reserve’s October meeting, at which two officials voted for another rate increase.

Sentiment took a further knock late on Tuesday when Stan Druckenmiller, among the best-known backers of copper’s AI trade, told a conference in Austin he is now short the metal. A filing earlier in the week showed his family office had sold out of Southern Copper and bought gold miners during the third quarter.

Druckenmiller exits copper, steel and chip stocks to buy gold miners

Fund positioning has already been cut hard. Managed money net long positions on Comex have fallen from more than 80,000 contracts six weeks ago to about 35,000, close to a 14-month low, according to Saxo. Hansen put the next chart supports at $5.63 and $5.32 a pound. The first of those, which is also where copper ended 2025, gave way later in the session.

Record premium, falling price

The rout comes with the physical market in China as tight as it has been in years. The Yangshan premium paid to import copper into the country jumped by about a fifth to a record $360 a tonne on Wednesday, Reuters reports, up from less than $100 in September. Shanghai Futures Exchange stocks dropped 18% last week to 27,642 tonnes, the lowest since December 2023, and the November contract expired on Monday at a premium of more than $2,000 a tonne to December, a squeeze that forced the exchange to intervene .

Investors increasingly doubt the Trump administration will press ahead with tariffs on refined copper after this month’s midterm elections, and the spike in Chinese prices has created the commercial case for traders to ship metal out of the United States, where warehouses hold roughly 85% of the 1.09 million tonnes in exchange-monitored stocks. The assumption that those inventories would stay stranded unless tariffs were formally ruled out has been shaken, Bloomberg reports.

Supply news ignored

Chile’s copper commission Cochilco expects national output to fall 8.4% this year to 4.94 million tonnes, the lowest in 23 years , after production dropped 8.5% to 3.63 million tonnes in the first nine months. The country’s leaching operations are also exposed to sulphuric acid supply: imports hit a record 3.97 million tonnes last year, about half of consumption, and China supplied 37% of that before restricting exports in May.

In Shanghai, where the industry has gathered for annual supply talks, China’s Nonferrous Metals Industry Association said concentrate-fed smelting capacity has nearly reached a ceiling and promised a monitoring mechanism to bring treatment charges back to sustainable levels. Spot charges sank to a record minus $247.20 a tonne on November 6, meaning smelters pay miners for the privilege of processing their concentrate.

The 2026 benchmark was set at zero, and 21 of 35 industry participants polled by Reuters expect a negative number for 2027, with forecasts from minus $50 to minus $150. Snowdon argued that the more negative the benchmark, the healthier the market in the long run. Freeport Indonesia is meanwhile offering 2027 cathode from its Manyar smelter to Chinese buyers at a premium of $158 a tonne, Reuters reports, citing two sources.

The MINING.COM TOP 50 ranking of the world’s most valuable miners had already lost $226 billion in October.

The top 50 biggest mining companies in the world

(With files from Reuters and Bloomberg)

item.description:
Elisa Anzolin
[ミラノ １８日 ロイター] - コンサルティング会社ベイン・アンド・カンパニーは１８日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
高級品市場、26年に不振脱却の兆し　長期はなお不透明感＝ベイン 0:51 配信

イタリア・ミラノの「ガレリア・ヴィットーリオ・エマヌエーレ２世」で1月12日撮影。REUTERS/Daniele Mascolo（ロイター） Elisa Anzolin

[ミラノ　１８日　ロイター] - コンサルティング会社ベイン・アンド・カンパニーは１８日、２０２６年の個人向け高級品市場はここ２年程度の不振から脱却する兆しがあるとの見通しを明らかにした。ただ、長期的にはなお不透明感が残ると指摘した。

世界の個人向け高級品の２６年の売上高は、現在の為替レートで前年比約２％増の３６７０億ユーロ（約４０３０億ドル）と見込む。過去１５年間の年平均増加率５％を下回る見通しだ。２７年は、横ばいから４％程度の増加の間になると予測している。

ベインは、２７年も米州が引き続きけん引すると予想する一方、新型コロナウイルス禍前に好調だった中国は、不振が続くと見込む。欧州は、中東情勢により混乱した観光客の回復に伴い、安定化すると見ている。

顧客基盤は２５年の３億３０００万人から、２６年には３億１５００万人に減少すると推定。消費性向が旅行や高級ダイニングなどにシフトしていることなどを要因に挙げた。富裕層による支出が全体をカバーしたり、衣類よりもジュエリー類に堅調さが見られたりする傾向があるという。このほか、中国や米国では自国産のブランドに対する関心の高まりも見られるという。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は今年に入って２０％超下落。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の下落が高級ブランドの消費にも悪影響を及ぼす可能性が指摘されている。

item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅仮契約指数、10月は調査開始以来最低　金利上昇重し 0:40 配信

7月14日、米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスで売却済みの住宅を示す不動産の看板。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） [ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１８日発表した１０月の米中古住宅販売仮契約指数は前月比で４．７％低下の６３．０と、２００１年の統計開始以来の低水準となった。住宅ローン金利の上昇が住宅需要を抑制していることが背景にある。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は２．０％低下だった。大幅な低下は、先月に続き２カ月連続となった。

前年同月比では１６．７％低下した。契約件数は４地域全てで減少した。

米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が続く中、住宅ローン金利は高止まりしている。住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローンの先週の平均金利は７．１８％だった。１０月半ばには、約３年ぶりの高水準となる７．４０％まで上昇していた。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「販売仮契約指数が２カ月連続で過去最低となったことは、第４・四半期の住宅成約が極めて低調になることを示している。中古住宅の年間販売件数は１９９０年代半ば以来の低水準となる可能性がある」と述べた。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＵＢＳ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種の27年末目標を8200に設定　好調な業績支え 0:20 配信

8月18日、米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [１８日 ロイター] - ＵＢＳグローバル・ウェルス・マネジメントは１８日、米主要株価指数のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の２０２７年末の目標を８２００に設定した。堅調な経済成長と好調な企業収益に支えられるとの見方を示した。

ただ、高過ぎる業績期待や人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る不透明感が依然として残っていることが、一段の上昇を抑える可能性があるとも指摘。市場の関心は、現在のＡＩ投資サイクルが２７年以降も利益成長を支えられるかどうかに移っていると分析した。

ＵＢＳは、米国株を「中立（ニュートラル）」に引き下げた上で、「ＡＩを巡るカニバリゼーション（共食い）、資金調達、実行リスクが高まっている一方、期待感や指数への集中度は依然として高い」と指摘。「上昇は見込まれるものの、その過程は変動が激しい可能性がある」と述べた。

このＳ＆Ｐ５００指数の２７年目標値は、現行水準から約１２％の上昇余地を示唆しており、ウェルズ・ファーゴの見方と概ね一致するものの、ゴールドマン・サックスやモルガン・スタンレーのより強気な予想を下回っている。

ＵＢＳは、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の業績は２６年に２９％増加し、２７年にはさらに１５％拡大するとの見通しを示した。

また、世界のＡＩ関連投資は２７年には１兆４０００億ドルに増加し、２８年には１兆５０００億ドルに達すると予想。「業績の伸びは鈍化するものの、底堅い経済活動と継続的なＡＩ投資が２７年の利益を支えると見込む」との見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米株、下半期の上昇基調維持に多くの試練　ＡＩ投資から金融政策まで アングル：ハイテク株への依存度を高める米株価指数、新たなリスクも 焦点：最高値圏に戻した米株、投機ポジションやオプション取引は一段高示唆 焦点：米株がイラン攻撃前の水準回復、短期終結への期待変わらず 焦点：米株の上昇銘柄に広がり　テック一辺倒から変化の兆し 11/19(木) 0:20 最終更新 ロイター

item.content:encoded:
中国、エヌビディア製半導体確保目指す　ＡＩ兵器向け＝報告書 0:02 配信

6月11日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo（ロイター） [１８日 ロイター] - 中国軍が人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した兵器向けに、米半導体大手エヌビディア 製の最先端半導体の調達を目指していることが、１８日に公表された米議会委員会の年次報告書で明らかになった。中国製ＡＩ半導体が依然、米国の競合他社に遅れをとっていることが背景にある。

米中経済安全保障調査委員会は報告書で、中国当局が「智能化」戦争の推進に不可欠な先端半導体を確保するため、米国の輸出規制を回避しようとしていると指摘した。

報告書によると、中国の華為技術（ファーウェイ）や中科寒武紀科技（カンブリコン）などの最先端ＡＩ半導体は依然としてエヌビディアや米ＡＭＤ製に及ばないという。

エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン前最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は先週、不倫騒動の中辞任した。フアン氏と不倫関係があったとされる中国人実業家の女性は中国のスパイだったと疑われている。

エヌビディアは米国の輸出規制により中国のＡＩデータセンター市場から事実上締め出されているとしている。しかし、ロイターの調査では、同社の規制対象となっている半導体を前提とした中国のコンピューティング事業の規模は総額３０億ドルを超えることが分かっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ投資に迫られる「総点検」、見えないリスクの把握急務に アングル：「フアン氏の代わりはいない」、ＡＩ業界　最大級の擁護者失うリスク アングル：中国「独身の日」、世界最大級セールでＡＩトークンが新たな目玉に アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 11/19(木) 0:02 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: ＦＲＢ、積極的な物価対応必要 来月0.5％利上げも＝ウォラー理事
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１８...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＦＲＢ、積極的な物価対応必要　来月0.5％利上げも＝ウォラー理事 11/18 23:45 配信

１１月１７日撮影　REUTERS/David 'Dee' Delgado（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォラー理事は１８日、インフレによって国民の物価に対する心理が変化しつつあることを懸念しており、ＦＲＢはインフレに一段と積極的に対応する必要があるとの認識を示した。その上で、１２月の次回会合で０．５％ポイントの利上げを決定するか、来年に一段と速いペースで利上げを進める方針を市場に示すべきとの考えを示した。

ウォラー氏はＣＮＢＣのインタビューに対し「インフレは望ましくない方向に向かっており、その広がりも見られる」とし、足元で価格上昇が加速している品目の多くがサービス部門に属しており、高騰する原油価格やその他の一時的要因の影響を主に受けているわけではないと指摘。「インフレを本当に抑制したいなら、一段と積極的な措置を取り始めなければならない」とし、１２月８─９日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で通常より大幅な０．５％ポイントの利上げを決定するか、ＦＯＭＣ声明のほか、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長のＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見を通じて、今後の追加利上げに対する市場の期待形成を図るべきとの考えを示した。

その上で、インフレ率はこのところ年率換算で３％を上回る水準で推移しており、加速している可能性もあると指摘。企業経営者がこうした水準を「通常」と受け止め、その分を消費者価格に転嫁するべきと考え始めていることを懸念していると述べた。「『３％程度の値上げなら受け入れられると考え、その分を価格に転嫁した』という声が聞かれ始めている。そうなるとインフレを引き下げるのが難しくなる。今後の基準として考えるべき数字は３％ではないと人々に認識してもらう必要がある。われわれは、こうした心理を打ち破らなければならない」とし、「今後２年かけて取り組むような話ではない」と述べ、迅速な対応の必要性を強調した。

ウォラー理事は１０日、米国の１０月のインフレ率が鈍化したとしてもＦＲＢは１２月の会合で利上げを支持する考えを示し、物価情勢が悪化した場合は０．５％ポイントの大幅利上げを検討する必要があると発言。ウォラー氏の発言後に米労働省が発表した１０月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比０．４％上昇し、市場予想（０．３％）を上回った。

ウォラー氏はこの日のインタビューで、現時点での選択肢は、０．５％ポイントの利上げを実施して市場が織り込む０．２５％ポイント利上げの見通しを覆すか、来年１月にも追加利上げを行い、その後も利上げを継続する方針を極めて明確に示すかのいずれかだと指摘。こうした方針はＦＯＭＣ声明で示すこともできるほか、「ＦＲＢ議長が記者会見で言及することもできる」と指摘。「何らかの対応が必要だ」とし、「そうでなければ１２月に０．５％ポイントの利上げを実施しなければならない。それを決めて実行すべきだ」と語った。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長はできる限り「フォワードガイダンス（将来の政策方針に関する事前説明）」を避けたいとの考えを示しているが、ウォラー理事は現在のような局面ではＦＲＢが強力なコミュニケーションを活用し、インフレ心理の高まりを抑制する必要があると指摘。「議長には自身のコミュニケーション手法があり、それは構わない。それが議長の考え方だ」とした上で、「私は長年この仕事に携わってきた。コミュニケーションは政策手段の一つとして活用すべきだ。市場がわれわれの仕事を後押しするよう、コミュニケーションを活用するべきだ」と語った。

ＦＲＢは９月のＦＯＭＣで０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定。利上げは２０２３年７月以来、３年２カ月ぶりだった。１０月のＦＯＭＣではフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定したが、１２月８─９日の次回ＦＯＭＣでは少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定するとの見方が大勢になっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：米10年債利回り、利上げ局面でどこまで上昇　6％到達も視野 アングル：ＦＯＭＣで利上げほぼ確実、ウォーシュ氏の政策説明も不可避か コラム：ＦＯＭＣと日銀会合、金融政策ウイークの注目点＝植野大作氏 11/18(水) 23:45 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Nov 18 : "Grand Theft Auto VI" is winning praise from players and critics as it rolls out worldwide, and Wall Street is joining the chorus. Shares of Take-Two Interactive, publisher of the latest edition in the iconic GTA franchise, surged more than 8 per cent on Wednesday as investors bet that glowing initial reviews will fuel demand further and boost the company's bookings and revenue this year. Players waited more than 13 years for GTA VI, and are now doing everything from taking several days of paid time off to signing "contracts" with their partners to get uninterrupted game time. The demand has been feverish. Even with a high bar for player satisfaction, GTA VI saw a flood of early positive reviews and clinched a score of 99 on aggregator site Metacritic.

"There may have been anxiety around GTA VI's ability to live up to the hype from a quality perspective. With the Metacritic score at 99, any questions around quality have been put to bed," said Nick McKay, video gaming and digital entertainment senior analyst at Freedom Capital Markets. "The wait appears to have been worth it for gamers and investors alike." Take-Two's stock, down 19 per cent this year through last close, was the top gainer in the Nasdaq-100 index on Wednesday. Wells Fargo analysts raised their estimates for GTA VI sales, projecting about 65 million units in its current fiscal year that runs through March, up from prior projections of 35 million units. The forecast is also underpinned by expectations for a potential PC release early in 2027. The brokerage raised its annual bookings forecast for Take-Two by 19 per cent to $9.76 billion, versus a consensus estimate of $8 billion from LSEG data, and Take-Two's own projection of $8 billion to $8.20 billion. GTA TIDE LIFTS MANY BOATS Another brokerage, Oppenheimer, estimates about $1.85 billion in gross revenue in the first three days, compared with the $1 billion recorded by its predecessor, GTA V, when it was released in 2013. The buzz is expected to lift the broader video game market, with industry researcher Newzoo forecasting 3 per cent growth in the global console player base in 2026, versus a likely decline in the market without GTA VI. "Few releases can change how the whole console market spends, and GTA VI is one of those rare titles," Newzoo's Director of Market Intelligence Emmanuel Rosier said. Analytics firm Sensor Tower estimates the launch will also generate more than 50 million additional visits to food delivery and restaurant apps within 30 days in the US, as gamers hunker down for extended play sessions. Social media apps including YouTube and Reddit are also expected to see greater engagement as fans discuss the game's features and share gameplay clips. Shares of DoorDash rose 2 per cent, while those of Reddit were marginally higher. As of Wednesday noon ET, roughly 17.1 million GTA VI units had been sold, a Sensor Tower tracker showed, far exceeding pre-order volumes of all the biggest game releases in recent history.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米10月一戸建て着工、前月比4.0％増　建設許可件数は急減 11/18 23:10 配信

米カリフォルニア州エンシニタスの新築の一戸建て住宅。8月20日撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン １８日 ロイター] - 米商務省国勢調査局が１８日発表した１０月の住宅着工件数（季節調整済み）は、住宅建設の大部分を占める一戸建てが年率換算で前月比４．０％増の８６万４０００戸となった。前月から回復したものの、住宅ローン金利の上昇やインフレを背景に建設許可件数が急減しており、今回の改善は一時的なものにとどまる公算が大きい。

一戸建て住宅の建設許可件数は８．７％減の７７万２０００戸に落ち込んだ。米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争が住宅ローン金利を押し上げ、多くの若年層が住宅市場から締め出されている。

キャピタル・エコノミクスの北米担当エコノミスト、ブラッドリー・ソーンダース氏は「住宅建設は依然として低迷している。高水準の借り入れコストが需要を圧迫すると同時に建設費を大幅に押し上げ、開発業者に打撃を与えている」と述べた。

住宅金融機関フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は、２月下旬の紛争開始以降１２０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）急上昇し、先週は平均７．１８％となった。

変動の大きい５戸以上の集合住宅の着工件数は前月比２５．５％増の年率換算４３万３０００戸と急増した。前年同月比では２２．０％増加した。

住宅着工件数全体は前月比９．９％増の年率換算１３０万９０００戸に回復した。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は１２４万５０００戸だった。前年同月比では２．８％増加した。

集合住宅の建設許可件数は前月比５．２％減の年率換算４７万５０００戸だった。建設許可件数全体は７．４％減の１２９万５０００戸。エコノミストは１３７万７０００戸への増加を予想していた。前年同月比では８．７％減少した。

高水準の住宅ローン金利が住宅需要を抑制していることに加え、トランプ政権による移民取り締まりも住宅建設を制約している。開発業者はエネルギーや資材の価格高騰によるコスト圧力の増大にも直面している

住宅建設を含む住宅投資は、直近１０四半期のうち８四半期で縮小している。ただ、住宅市場が国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）に占める割合は小さく、住宅市場の低迷が経済全体に与える打撃は軽微なものにとどまっている。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：協調介入の米関与は限定的の受け止め、円再び160円台に　安値試しも 焦点：米財政運営巡る政治対立リスク、民主党勝利で市場が注目 アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 11/19(木) 1:22 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 18 : A gauge of stocks across the globe fell on Wednesday after Nvidia's quarterly results and ahead of Anthropic's market debut, while the dollar's strength on the back of a hawkish Federal Reserve weighed on trader sentiment. The dollar index strengthened to a fresh 19-month high after US Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller told CNBC the central bank needs to either approve a half-point interest rate hike at its December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027. Mining stocks dragged European shares lower, while Nvidia's results initially helped Asian shares, with South Korea's Kospi up 2 per cent overnight. But the Nvidia rally fizzled and its stock fell 2.9 per cent after rising as much as 2.7 per cent. Nvidia's board dismissed the idea of rehiring former CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned last week. The company's results and strong outlook did not dispel uncertainty.
